content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

content.latin: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
content.english: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

content.latin: Ant. Regem Apostolórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Apostles, * O come, let us adore.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem Apostolórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
content.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us adore.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius (genuflectitur) veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
content.english: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. (genuflect) Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

segments.t: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius
(genuflectitur)
veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.

content.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Apostles, * O come, let us adore.

segments.t: Ant.
Regem Apostolórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
content.english: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

content.latin: Ant. Veníte, adorémus.
content.english: Ant. O come, let us adore.

segments.t: Ant.
Veníte, adorémus.

content.latin: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
content.english: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

content.latin: Quodcúmque in orbe néxibus revínxeris,
content.english: Peter, whatever thou shalt bind on earth,

content.latin: Erit revínctum, Petre, in arce síderum:
content.english: The same is bound above the starry sky;

content.latin: Et quod resólvit hic potéstas trádita,
content.english: What here thy delegated power doth loose,

content.latin: Erit solútum cæli in alto vértice;
content.english: Is loosed in heaven's supremest court on high:

content.latin: In fine mundi iudicábis sǽculum.
content.english: To judgement shalt thou come, when the world's end is nigh.

content.latin: Patri perénne sit per ævum glória,
content.english: Praise to the Father, through all ages be;

content.latin: Tibíque laudes concinámus ínclitas,
content.english: Praise to the consubstantial sovereign Son,

content.latin: Ætérne Nate; sit, supérne Spíritus,
content.english: And Holy Ghost, one glorious Trinity;

content.latin: Honor tibi decúsque: sancta iúgiter
content.english: To whom all majesty and might belong;

content.latin: Laudétur omne Trínitas per sǽculum.
content.english: So sing we now, and such be our eternal song.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 18 [1]
content.english: Psalm 18 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 18

content.latin: 18:2 Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum eius annúntiat firmaméntum.
content.english: 18:2 The heavens shew forth the glory of God, * and the firmament declareth the work of his hands.

segments.t: Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum eius annúntiat firmaméntum.

content.latin: 18:3 Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.
content.english: 18:3 Day to day uttereth speech, * and night to night sheweth knowledge.

segments.t: Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.

content.latin: 18:4 Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.
content.english: 18:4 There are no speeches nor languages, * where their voices are not heard.

segments.t: Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.

content.latin: 18:5 In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
content.english: 18:5 Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth: * and their words unto the ends of the world.

segments.t: In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.

content.latin: 18:6 In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:
content.english: 18:6 He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: * and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber,

segments.t: In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:

content.latin: 18:6 Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * a summo cælo egréssio eius:
content.english: 18:6 Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way: * his going out is from the end of heaven,

segments.t: Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * a summo cælo egréssio eius:

content.latin: 18:7 Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre eius.
content.english: 18:7 And his circuit even to the end thereof: * and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.

segments.t: Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre eius.

content.latin: 18:8 Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.
content.english: 18:8 The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls: * the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.

segments.t: Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.

content.latin: 18:9 Iustítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.
content.english: 18:9 The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: * the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.

segments.t: Iustítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.

content.latin: 18:10 Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * iudícia Dómini vera, iustificáta in semetípsa.
content.english: 18:10 The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for ever and ever: * the judgments of the Lord are true, justified in themselves.

segments.t: Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * iudícia Dómini vera, iustificáta in semetípsa.

content.latin: 18:11 Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.
content.english: 18:11 More to be desired than gold and many precious stones: * and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.

segments.t: Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.

content.latin: 18:12 Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.
content.english: 18:12 For thy servant keepeth them, * and in keeping them there is a great reward.

segments.t: Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.

content.latin: 18:13 Delícta quis intéllegit? ab occúltis meis munda me: * et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
content.english: 18:13 Who can understand sins? from my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord: * and from those of others spare thy servant.

segments.t: Delícta quis intéllegit? ab occúltis meis munda me: * et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.

content.latin: 18:14 Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.
content.english: 18:14 If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: * and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin.

segments.t: Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.

content.latin: 18:15 Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.
content.english: 18:15 And the words of my mouth shall be such as may please: * and the meditation of my heart always in thy sight.

segments.t: Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.

content.latin: 18:15 Dómine, adiútor meus, * et redémptor meus.
content.english: 18:15 O Lord, my helper, * and my redeemer.

segments.t: Dómine, adiútor meus, * et redémptor meus.

content.latin: Psalmus 33 [2]
content.english: Psalm 33 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 33

content.latin: 33:2 Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus eius in ore meo.
content.english: 33:2 I will bless the Lord at all times, * his praise shall be always in my mouth.

segments.t: Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus eius in ore meo.

content.latin: 33:3 In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.
content.english: 33:3 In the Lord shall my soul be praised: * let the meek hear and rejoice.

segments.t: In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.

content.latin: 33:4 Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen eius in idípsum.
content.english: 33:4 O magnify the Lord with me; * and let us extol his name together.

segments.t: Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen eius in idípsum.

content.latin: 33:5 Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.
content.english: 33:5 I sought the Lord, and he heard me; * and he delivered me from all my troubles.

segments.t: Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.

content.latin: 33:6 Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.
content.english: 33:6 Come ye to him and be enlightened: * and your faces shall not be confounded.

segments.t: Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.

content.latin: 33:7 Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus eius salvávit eum.
content.english: 33:7 This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: * and saved him out of all his troubles.

segments.t: Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus eius salvávit eum.

content.latin: 33:8 Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.
content.english: 33:8 The Angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear him: * and shall deliver them.

segments.t: Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.

content.latin: 33:9 Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.
content.english: 33:9 O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: * blessed is the man that hopeth in him.

segments.t: Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.

content.latin: 33:10 Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti eius: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.
content.english: 33:10 Fear the Lord, all ye his saints: * for there is no want to them that fear him.

segments.t: Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti eius: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 33:11 Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.
content.english: 33:11 The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: * but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good.

segments.t: Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.

content.latin: 33:12 Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.
content.english: 33:12 Come, children, hearken to me: * I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

segments.t: Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.

content.latin: 33:13 Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?
content.english: 33:13 Who is the man that desireth life: * who loveth to see good days?

segments.t: Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?

content.latin: 33:14 Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.
content.english: 33:14 Keep thy tongue from evil, * and thy lips from speaking guile.

segments.t: Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.

content.latin: 33:15 Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.
content.english: 33:15 Turn away from evil and do good: * seek after peace and pursue it.

segments.t: Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.

content.latin: 33:16 Óculi Dómini super iustos: * et aures eius in preces eórum.
content.english: 33:16 The eyes of the Lord are upon the just: * and his ears unto their prayers.

segments.t: Óculi Dómini super iustos: * et aures eius in preces eórum.

content.latin: 33:17 Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.
content.english: 33:17 But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: * to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

segments.t: Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.

content.latin: 33:18 Clamavérunt iusti, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.
content.english: 33:18 The just cried, and the Lord heard them: * and delivered them out of all their troubles.

segments.t: Clamavérunt iusti, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.

content.latin: 33:19 Iuxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.
content.english: 33:19 The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart: * and he will save the humble of spirit.

segments.t: Iuxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.

content.latin: 33:20 Multæ tribulatiónes iustórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.
content.english: 33:20 Many are the afflictions of the just; * but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.

segments.t: Multæ tribulatiónes iustórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.

content.latin: 33:21 Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.
content.english: 33:21 The Lord keepeth all their bones, * not one of them shall be broken.

segments.t: Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.

content.latin: 33:22 Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt iustum, delínquent.
content.english: 33:22 The death of the wicked is very evil: * and they that hate the just shall be guilty.

segments.t: Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt iustum, delínquent.

content.latin: 33:23 Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
content.english: 33:23 The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: * and none of them that trust in him shall offend.

segments.t: Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.

content.english: Ant. Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

content.latin: Psalmus 44 [3]
content.english: Psalm 44 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 44

content.latin: 44:2 Eructávit cor meum verbum bonum: * dico ego ópera mea Regi.
content.english: 44:2 My heart hath uttered a good word; * I speak my works to the King.

segments.t: Eructávit cor meum verbum bonum: * dico ego ópera mea Regi.

content.latin: 44:2 Lingua mea cálamus scribæ: * velóciter scribéntis.
content.english: 44:2 My tongue is the pen of a scrivener * that writeth swiftly.

segments.t: Lingua mea cálamus scribæ: * velóciter scribéntis.

content.latin: 44:3 Speciósus forma præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis: * proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
content.english: 44:3 Thou art beautiful above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips; * therefore hath God blessed thee for ever.

segments.t: Speciósus forma præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis: * proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.

content.latin: 44:4 Accíngere gládio tuo super femur tuum, * potentíssime.
content.english: 44:4 Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, * O thou most mighty.

segments.t: Accíngere gládio tuo super femur tuum, * potentíssime.

content.latin: 44:5 Spécie tua et pulchritúdine tua: * inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
content.english: 44:5 With thy comeliness and thy beauty * set out, proceed prosperously, and reign.

segments.t: Spécie tua et pulchritúdine tua: * inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.

content.latin: 44:5 Propter veritátem, et mansuetúdinem, et iustítiam: * et dedúcet te mirabíliter déxtera tua.
content.english: 44:5 Because of truth and meekness and justice: * and thy right hand shall conduct thee wonderfully.

segments.t: Propter veritátem, et mansuetúdinem, et iustítiam: * et dedúcet te mirabíliter déxtera tua.

content.latin: 44:6 Sagíttæ tuæ acútæ, pópuli sub te cadent: * in corda inimicórum Regis.
content.english: 44:6 Thy arrows are sharp: under thee shall people fall, * into the hearts of the king’s enemies.

segments.t: Sagíttæ tuæ acútæ, pópuli sub te cadent: * in corda inimicórum Regis.

content.latin: 44:7 Sedes tua, Deus, in sǽculum sǽculi: * virga directiónis virga regni tui.
content.english: 44:7 Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: * the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of uprightness.

segments.t: Sedes tua, Deus, in sǽculum sǽculi: * virga directiónis virga regni tui.

content.latin: 44:8 Dilexísti iustítiam, et odísti iniquitátem: * proptérea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, óleo lætítiæ præ consórtibus tuis.
content.english: 44:8 Thou hast loved justice, and hated iniquity: * therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

segments.t: Dilexísti iustítiam, et odísti iniquitátem: * proptérea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, óleo lætítiæ præ consórtibus tuis.

content.latin: 44:9 Myrrha, et gutta, et cásia a vestiméntis tuis, a dómibus ebúrneis: * ex quibus delectavérunt te fíliæ regum in honóre tuo.
content.english: 44:9 Myrrh and stacte and cassia perfume thy garments, from the ivory houses: * out of which the daughters of kings have delighted thee in thy glory.

segments.t: Myrrha, et gutta, et cásia a vestiméntis tuis, a dómibus ebúrneis: * ex quibus delectavérunt te fíliæ regum in honóre tuo.

content.latin: 44:10 Ástitit regína a dextris tuis in vestítu deauráto: * circúmdata varietáte.
content.english: 44:10 The queen stood on thy right hand, in gilded clothing; * surrounded with variety.

segments.t: Ástitit regína a dextris tuis in vestítu deauráto: * circúmdata varietáte.

content.latin: 44:11 Audi fília, et vide, et inclína aurem tuam: * et oblivíscere pópulum tuum et domum patris tui.
content.english: 44:11 Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thy ear: * and forget thy people and thy father’s house.

segments.t: Audi fília, et vide, et inclína aurem tuam: * et oblivíscere pópulum tuum et domum patris tui.

content.latin: 44:12 Et concupíscet Rex decórem tuum: * quóniam ipse est Dóminus Deus tuus, et adorábunt eum.
content.english: 44:12 And the king shall greatly desire thy beauty; * for he is the Lord thy God, and him they shall adore.

segments.t: Et concupíscet Rex decórem tuum: * quóniam ipse est Dóminus Deus tuus, et adorábunt eum.

content.latin: 44:13 Et fíliæ Tyri in munéribus * vultum tuum deprecabúntur: omnes dívites plebis.
content.english: 44:13 And the daughters of Tyre with gifts, * yea, all the rich among the people, shall entreat thy countenance.

segments.t: Et fíliæ Tyri in munéribus * vultum tuum deprecabúntur: omnes dívites plebis.

content.latin: 44:14 Omnis glória eius fíliæ Regis ab intus, * in fímbriis áureis circumamícta varietátibus.
content.english: 44:14 All the glory of the king’s daughter is within, * in golden borders, clothed round about with varieties.

segments.t: Omnis glória eius fíliæ Regis ab intus, * in fímbriis áureis circumamícta varietátibus.

content.latin: 44:15 Adducéntur Regi vírgines post eam: * próximæ eius afferéntur tibi.
content.english: 44:15 After her shall virgins be brought to the king: * her neighbours shall be brought to thee.

segments.t: Adducéntur Regi vírgines post eam: * próximæ eius afferéntur tibi.

content.latin: 44:16 Afferéntur in lætítia et exsultatióne: * adducéntur in templum Regis.
content.english: 44:16 They shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing: * they shall be brought into the temple of the king.

segments.t: Afferéntur in lætítia et exsultatióne: * adducéntur in templum Regis.

content.latin: 44:17 Pro pátribus tuis nati sunt tibi fílii: * constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.
content.english: 44:17 Instead of thy fathers, sons are born to thee: * thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.

segments.t: Pro pátribus tuis nati sunt tibi fílii: * constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.

content.latin: 44:18 Mémores erunt nóminis tui: * in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
content.english: 44:18 They shall remember thy name * throughout all generations.

segments.t: Mémores erunt nóminis tui: * in omni generatióne et generatiónem.

content.latin: 44:18 Proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum: * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 44:18 Therefore shall people praise thee for ever; yea, * for ever and ever.

segments.t: Proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum: * et in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram: mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Thou shalt make them princes over all the earth. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram: mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.

content.latin: Ant. Príncipes populórum * congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham.
content.english: Ant. The princes of the people * are gathered together, with the God of Abraham.

segments.t: Ant.
Príncipes populórum * congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham.

content.latin: Psalmus 46 [4]
content.english: Psalm 46 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 46

content.latin: 46:2 Omnes gentes, pláudite mánibus: * iubiláte Deo in voce exsultatiónis.
content.english: 46:2 O clap your hands, all ye nations: * shout unto God with the voice of joy,

segments.t: Omnes gentes, pláudite mánibus: * iubiláte Deo in voce exsultatiónis.

content.latin: 46:3 Quóniam Dóminus excélsus, terríbilis: * Rex magnus super omnem terram.
content.english: 46:3 For the Lord is high, terrible: * a great king over all the earth.

segments.t: Quóniam Dóminus excélsus, terríbilis: * Rex magnus super omnem terram.

content.latin: 46:4 Subiécit pópulos nobis: * et gentes sub pédibus nostris.
content.english: 46:4 He hath subdued the people under us; * and the nations under our feet.

segments.t: Subiécit pópulos nobis: * et gentes sub pédibus nostris.

content.latin: 46:5 Elégit nobis hereditátem suam: * spéciem Iacob, quam diléxit.
content.english: 46:5 He hath chosen for us his inheritance, * the beauty of Jacob which he hath loved.

segments.t: Elégit nobis hereditátem suam: * spéciem Iacob, quam diléxit.

content.latin: 46:6 Ascéndit Deus in iúbilo: * et Dóminus in voce tubæ.
content.english: 46:6 God is ascended with jubilee, * and the Lord with the sound of trumpet.

segments.t: Ascéndit Deus in iúbilo: * et Dóminus in voce tubæ.

content.latin: 46:7 Psállite Deo nostro, psállite: * psállite Regi nostro, psállite.
content.english: 46:7 Sing praises to our God, sing ye: * sing praises to our king, sing ye.

segments.t: Psállite Deo nostro, psállite: * psállite Regi nostro, psállite.

content.latin: 46:8 Quóniam Rex omnis terræ Deus: * psállite sapiénter.
content.english: 46:8 For God is the king of all the earth: * sing ye wisely.

segments.t: Quóniam Rex omnis terræ Deus: * psállite sapiénter.

content.latin: 46:9 Regnábit Deus super gentes: * Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam.
content.english: 46:9 God shall reign over the nations: * God sitteth on his holy throne.

segments.t: Regnábit Deus super gentes: * Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam.

content.latin: 46:10 Príncipes populórum congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham: * quóniam dii fortes terræ veheménter eleváti sunt.
content.english: 46:10 The princes of the people are gathered together, with the God of Abraham: * for the strong gods of the earth are exceedingly exalted.

segments.t: Príncipes populórum congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham: * quóniam dii fortes terræ veheménter eleváti sunt.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. The princes of the people are gathered together, with the God of Abraham.

segments.t: Ant.
Príncipes populórum congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham.

content.latin: Ant. Dedísti hereditátem * timéntibus nomen tuum, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Thou hast given an inheritance * to them that fear thy name, O Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Dedísti hereditátem * timéntibus nomen tuum, Dómine.

content.latin: Psalmus 60 [5]
content.english: Psalm 60 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 60

content.latin: 60:2 Exáudi, Deus, deprecatiónem meam: * inténde oratióni meæ.
content.english: 60:2 Hear, O God, my supplication: * be attentive to my prayer.

segments.t: Exáudi, Deus, deprecatiónem meam: * inténde oratióni meæ.

content.latin: 60:3 A fínibus terræ ad te clamávi: * dum anxiarétur cor meum, in petra exaltásti me.
content.english: 60:3 To thee have I cried from the ends of the earth: * when my heart was in anguish, thou hast exalted me on a rock.

segments.t: A fínibus terræ ad te clamávi: * dum anxiarétur cor meum, in petra exaltásti me.

content.latin: 60:4 Deduxísti me, quia factus es spes mea: * turris fortitúdinis a fácie inimíci.
content.english: 60:4 Thou hast conducted me; for thou hast been my hope: * a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.

segments.t: Deduxísti me, quia factus es spes mea: * turris fortitúdinis a fácie inimíci.

content.latin: 60:5 Inhabitábo in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula: * prótegar in velaménto alárum tuárum.
content.english: 60:5 In thy tabernacle I shall dwell for ever: * I shall be protected under the covert of thy wings.

segments.t: Inhabitábo in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula: * prótegar in velaménto alárum tuárum.

content.latin: 60:6 Quóniam tu, Deus meus, exaudísti oratiónem meam: * dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum.
content.english: 60:6 For thou, my God, hast heard my prayer: * thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear thy name.

segments.t: Quóniam tu, Deus meus, exaudísti oratiónem meam: * dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum.

content.latin: 60:7 Dies super dies regis adícies: * annos eius usque in diem generatiónis et generatiónis.
content.english: 60:7 Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: * his years even to generation and generation.

segments.t: Dies super dies regis adícies: * annos eius usque in diem generatiónis et generatiónis.

content.latin: 60:8 Pérmanet in ætérnum in conspéctu Dei: * misericórdiam et veritátem eius quis requíret?
content.english: 60:8 He abideth for ever in the sight of God: * his mercy and truth who shall search?

segments.t: Pérmanet in ætérnum in conspéctu Dei: * misericórdiam et veritátem eius quis requíret?

content.latin: 60:9 Sic psalmum dicam nómini tuo in sǽculum sǽculi: * ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
content.english: 60:9 So will I sing a psalm to thy name for ever and ever: * that I may pay my vows from day to day.

segments.t: Sic psalmum dicam nómini tuo in sǽculum sǽculi: * ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. Thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear thy name, O Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum, Dómine.

content.latin: Ant. Annuntiavérunt * ópera Dei, et facta eius intellexérunt.
content.english: Ant. They declared * the works of God, and understood his doings.

segments.t: Ant.
Annuntiavérunt * ópera Dei, et facta eius intellexérunt.

content.latin: Psalmus 63 [6]
content.english: Psalm 63 [6]

segments.t: Psalmus 63

content.latin: 63:2 Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam cum déprecor: * a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam.
content.english: 63:2 Hear, O God, my prayer, when I make supplication to thee: * deliver my soul from the fear of the enemy.

segments.t: Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam cum déprecor: * a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam.

content.latin: 63:3 Protexísti me a convéntu malignántium: * a multitúdine operántium iniquitátem.
content.english: 63:3 Thou hast protected me from the assembly of the malignant; * from the multitude of the workers of iniquity.

segments.t: Protexísti me a convéntu malignántium: * a multitúdine operántium iniquitátem.

content.latin: 63:4 Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas: * intendérunt arcum rem amáram, ut sagíttent in occúltis immaculátum.
content.english: 63:4 For they have whetted their tongues like a sword; * they have bent their bow a bitter thing, to shoot in secret the undefiled.

segments.t: Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas: * intendérunt arcum rem amáram, ut sagíttent in occúltis immaculátum.

content.latin: 63:6 Súbito sagittábunt eum, et non timébunt: * firmavérunt sibi sermónem nequam.
content.english: 63:6 They will shoot at him on a sudden, and will not fear: * they are resolute in wickedness.

segments.t: Súbito sagittábunt eum, et non timébunt: * firmavérunt sibi sermónem nequam.

content.latin: 63:6 Narravérunt ut abscónderent láqueos: * dixérunt: Quis vidébit eos?
content.english: 63:6 They have talked of hiding snares; * they have said: Who shall see them?

segments.t: Narravérunt ut abscónderent láqueos: * dixérunt: Quis vidébit eos?

content.latin: 63:7 Scrutáti sunt iniquitátes: * defecérunt scrutántes scrutínio.
content.english: 63:7 They have searched after iniquities: * they have failed in their search.

segments.t: Scrutáti sunt iniquitátes: * defecérunt scrutántes scrutínio.

content.latin: 63:7 Accédet homo ad cor altum: * et exaltábitur Deus.
content.english: 63:7 Man shall come to a deep heart: * and God shall be exalted.

segments.t: Accédet homo ad cor altum: * et exaltábitur Deus.

content.latin: 63:8 Sagíttæ parvulórum factæ sunt plagæ eórum: * et infirmátæ sunt contra eos linguæ eórum.
content.english: 63:8 The arrows of children are their wounds: * and their tongues against them are made weak.

segments.t: Sagíttæ parvulórum factæ sunt plagæ eórum: * et infirmátæ sunt contra eos linguæ eórum.

content.latin: 63:9 Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos: * et tímuit omnis homo.
content.english: 63:9 All that saw them were troubled; * and every man was afraid.

segments.t: Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos: * et tímuit omnis homo.

content.latin: 63:10 Et annuntiavérunt ópera Dei, * et facta eius intellexérunt.
content.english: 63:10 And they declared the works of God: * and understood his doings.

segments.t: Et annuntiavérunt ópera Dei, * et facta eius intellexérunt.

content.latin: 63:11 Lætábitur iustus in Dómino, et sperábit in eo, * et laudabúntur omnes recti corde.
content.english: 63:11 The just shall rejoice in the Lord, and shall hope in him: * and all the upright in heart shall be praised.

segments.t: Lætábitur iustus in Dómino, et sperábit in eo, * et laudabúntur omnes recti corde.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: Ant. Exaltabúntur * córnua iusti, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. The horns of the just * shall be exalted. Alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Exaltabúntur * córnua iusti, allelúia.

content.latin: Psalmus 74 [7]
content.english: Psalm 74 [7]

segments.t: Psalmus 74

content.latin: 74:2 Confitébimur tibi, Deus: * confitébimur, et invocábimus nomen tuum.
content.english: 74:2 We will praise thee, O God: * we will praise, and we will call upon thy name.

segments.t: Confitébimur tibi, Deus: * confitébimur, et invocábimus nomen tuum.

content.latin: 74:3 Narrábimus mirabília tua: * cum accépero tempus, ego iustítias iudicábo.
content.english: 74:3 We will relate thy wondrous works: * when I shall take a time, I will judge justices.

segments.t: Narrábimus mirabília tua: * cum accépero tempus, ego iustítias iudicábo.

content.latin: 74:4 Liquefácta est terra, et omnes qui hábitant in ea: * ego confirmávi colúmnas eius.
content.english: 74:4 The earth is melted, and all that dwell therein: * I have established the pillars thereof.

segments.t: Liquefácta est terra, et omnes qui hábitant in ea: * ego confirmávi colúmnas eius.

content.latin: 74:5 Dixi iníquis: Nolíte iníque ágere: * et delinquéntibus: Nolíte exaltáre cornu:
content.english: 74:5 I said to the wicked: Do not act wickedly: * and to the sinners: Lift not up the horn.

segments.t: Dixi iníquis: Nolíte iníque ágere: * et delinquéntibus: Nolíte exaltáre cornu:

content.latin: 74:6 Nolíte extóllere in altum cornu vestrum: * nolíte loqui advérsus Deum iniquitátem.
content.english: 74:6 Lift not up your horn on high: * speak not iniquity against God.

segments.t: Nolíte extóllere in altum cornu vestrum: * nolíte loqui advérsus Deum iniquitátem.

content.latin: 74:7 Quia neque ab Oriénte, neque ab Occidénte, neque a desértis móntibus: * quóniam Deus iudex est.
content.english: 74:7 For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert hills: * for God is the judge.

segments.t: Quia neque ab Oriénte, neque ab Occidénte, neque a desértis móntibus: * quóniam Deus iudex est.

content.latin: 74:8 Hunc humíliat, et hunc exáltat: * quia calix in manu Dómini vini meri plenus misto.
content.english: 74:8 One he putteth down, and another he lifteth up: * for in the hand of the Lord there is a cup of strong wine full of mixture.

segments.t: Hunc humíliat, et hunc exáltat: * quia calix in manu Dómini vini meri plenus misto.

content.latin: 74:9 Et inclinávit ex hoc in hoc: verúmtamen fæx eius non est exinaníta: * bibent omnes peccatóres terræ.
content.english: 74:9 And he hath poured it out from this to that: but the dregs thereof are not emptied: * all the sinners of the earth shall drink.

segments.t: Et inclinávit ex hoc in hoc: verúmtamen fæx eius non est exinaníta: * bibent omnes peccatóres terræ.

content.latin: 74:10 Ego autem annuntiábo in sǽculum: * cantábo Deo Iacob.
content.english: 74:10 But I will declare for ever: * I will sing to the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Ego autem annuntiábo in sǽculum: * cantábo Deo Iacob.

content.latin: 74:11 Et ómnia córnua peccatórum confríngam: * et exaltabúntur córnua iusti.
content.english: 74:11 And I will break all the horns of sinners: * but the horns of the just shall be exalted.

segments.t: Et ómnia córnua peccatórum confríngam: * et exaltabúntur córnua iusti.

segments.t: Psalmus 96

content.latin: 96:1 Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
content.english: 96:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.

content.latin: 96:2 Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.
content.english: 96:2 Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

segments.t: Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.

content.latin: 96:3 Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.
content.english: 96:3 A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.

segments.t: Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.

content.latin: 96:4 Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
content.english: 96:4 His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.

segments.t: Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.

content.latin: 96:5 Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
content.english: 96:5 The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

segments.t: Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.

content.latin: 96:6 Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.
content.english: 96:6 The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.

segments.t: Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.

content.latin: 96:7 Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.
content.english: 96:7 Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, * and that glory in their idols.

segments.t: Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.

content.latin: 96:7 Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
content.english: 96:7 Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.

segments.t: Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.

content.latin: 96:8 Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:
content.english: 96:8 And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

segments.t: Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:

content.latin: 96:9 Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
content.english: 96:9 For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.

content.latin: 96:10 Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
content.english: 96:10 You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.

segments.t: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.

content.latin: 96:11 Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.
content.english: 96:11 Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.

segments.t: Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.

content.latin: 96:12 Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.
content.english: 96:12 Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.

segments.t: Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.

segments.t: Psalmus 98

content.latin: 98:1 Dóminus regnávit, irascántur pópuli: * qui sedet super Chérubim, moveátur terra.
content.english: 98:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the people be angry: * he that sitteth on the cherubims: let the earth be moved.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, irascántur pópuli: * qui sedet super Chérubim, moveátur terra.

content.latin: 98:2 Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.
content.english: 98:2 The Lord is great in Sion, * and high above all people.

segments.t: Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.

content.latin: 98:3 Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis iudícium díligit.
content.english: 98:3 Let them give praise to thy great name: for it is terrible and holy: * and the king’s honour loveth judgment.

segments.t: Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis iudícium díligit.

content.latin: 98:4 Tu parásti directiónes: * iudícium et iustítiam in Iacob tu fecísti.
content.english: 98:4 Thou hast prepared directions: * thou hast done judgment and justice in Jacob.

segments.t: Tu parásti directiónes: * iudícium et iustítiam in Iacob tu fecísti.

content.latin: 98:5 Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum eius: * quóniam sanctum est.
content.english: 98:5 Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore his footstool, * for it is holy.

segments.t: Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum eius: * quóniam sanctum est.

content.latin: 98:6 Móyses et Aaron in sacerdótibus eius: * et Sámuel inter eos, qui ínvocant nomen eius:
content.english: 98:6 Moses and Aaron among his priests: * and Samuel among them that call upon his name.

segments.t: Móyses et Aaron in sacerdótibus eius: * et Sámuel inter eos, qui ínvocant nomen eius:

content.latin: 98:6 Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.
content.english: 98:6 They called upon the Lord, and he heard them: * he spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.

segments.t: Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.

content.latin: 98:7 Custodiébant testimónia eius, * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.
content.english: 98:7 They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them.

segments.t: Custodiébant testimónia eius, * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.

content.latin: 98:8 Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.
content.english: 98:8 Thou didst hear them, O Lord our God: * thou wast a merciful God to them, and taking vengeance on all their inventions.

segments.t: Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.

content.latin: 98:9 Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus, Deus noster.
content.english: 98:9 Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore at his holy mountain: * for the Lord our God is holy.

segments.t: Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus, Deus noster.

content.english: ℣. Thy friends, O Lord, are made exceedingly honourable.

segments.t: Nimis honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.

content.latin: ℟. Nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
content.english: ℟. Their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

segments.t: Nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.

content.latin: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

segments.t: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: Absolutio. A vínculis peccatórum nostrórum absólvat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus.
content.english: Absolution. May the Almighty and merciful Lord loose us from the bonds of our sins.

segments.t: Absolutio.

content.latin: De Actibus Apostolórum
content.english: From the Acts of the Apostles
Acts 12:1-5

content.latin: 1 Misit Heródes rex manus ut afflígeret quosdam de Ecclésia.
content.english: 1 And at the same time, Herod the king stretched forth his hands, to afflict some of the church.

segments.t: Misit Heródes rex manus ut afflígeret quosdam de Ecclésia.

content.latin: 2 Occídit autem Iacóbum, fratrem Ioánnis, gládio.
content.english: 2 And he killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

segments.t: Occídit autem Iacóbum, fratrem Ioánnis, gládio.

content.latin: 3 Videns autem quia placéret Iudǽis, appósuit ut apprehénderet et Petrum. Erant autem dies azymórum.
content.english: 3 And seeing that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to take up Peter also. Now it was in the days of the Azymes.

segments.t: Videns autem quia placéret Iudǽis, appósuit ut apprehénderet et Petrum. Erant autem dies azymórum.

content.latin: 4 Quem, cum apprehendísset, misit in cárcerem, tradens quátuor quaterniónibus mílitum custodiéndum, volens post Pascha prodúcere eum pópulo.
content.english: 4 And when he had apprehended him, he cast him into prison, delivering him to four files of soldiers to be kept, intending, after the pasch, to bring him forth to the people.

segments.t: Quem, cum apprehendísset, misit in cárcerem, tradens quátuor quaterniónibus mílitum custodiéndum, volens post Pascha prodúcere eum pópulo.

content.latin: 5 Et Petrus quidem servabátur in cárcere; orátio autem fiébat sine intermissióne ab Ecclésia ad Deum pro eo.
content.english: 5 Peter therefore was kept in prison. But prayer was made without ceasing by the church unto God for him.

segments.t: Et Petrus quidem servabátur in cárcere; orátio autem fiébat sine intermissióne ab Ecclésia ad Deum pro eo.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Simon Petre, ántequam de navi vocárem te, novi te et super plebem meam príncipem te constítui:
content.english: ℟. Simon Peter, before I called thee out of the ship, I knew thee, and appointed thee for a ruler over My people.

segments.t: Simon Petre, ántequam de navi vocárem te, novi te et super plebem meam príncipem te constítui:

content.latin: * Et claves regni cælórum trádidi tibi.
content.english: * And I have given unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven.

content.latin: ℣. Quodcúmque ligáveris super terram erit ligátum et in cælis; et quodcúmque sólveris super terram, erit solútum et in cælis.
content.english: ℣. Whatsoever, thou shalt bind on earth, shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth, shall be loosed in heaven.

segments.t: Quodcúmque ligáveris super terram erit ligátum et in cælis; et quodcúmque sólveris super terram, erit solútum et in cælis.

content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

content.english: Benediction. He whose feast-day we are keeping, be our Advocate with God.

Cuius festum cólimus, ipse intercédat pro nobis ad Dóminum.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: Acts 12:6-8

content.latin: 6 Cum autem productúrus eum esset Heródes, in ipsa nocte erat Petrus dórmiens inter duos mílites vinctus caténis duábus, et custódes ante óstium custodiébant cárcerem.
content.english: 6 And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

segments.t: Cum autem productúrus eum esset Heródes, in ipsa nocte erat Petrus dórmiens inter duos mílites vinctus caténis duábus, et custódes ante óstium custodiébant cárcerem.

content.latin: 7 Et ecce Angelus Dómini ástitit, et lumen refúlsit in habitáculo, percussóque látere Petri, excitávit eum, dicens: Surge velóciter. Et cecidérunt caténæ de mánibus eius.
content.english: 7 And behold an angel of the Lord stood by him: and a light shined in the room: and he striking Peter on the side, raised him up, saying: Arise quickly. And the chains fell off from his hands.

segments.t: Et ecce Angelus Dómini ástitit, et lumen refúlsit in habitáculo, percussóque látere Petri, excitávit eum, dicens: Surge velóciter. Et cecidérunt caténæ de mánibus eius.

content.latin: 8 Dixit autem Angelus ad eum: Præcíngere, et cálcea te cáligas tuas. Et fecit sic. Et dixit illi: Circúmda tibi vestiméntum tuum, et séquere me.
content.english: 8 And the angel said to him: Gird thyself, and put on thy sandals. And he did so. And he said to him: Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

content.latin: 9 Et éxiens sequebátur eum, et nesciébat quia verum est quod fiébat per Angelum; existimábat autem se visum vidére.
content.english: 9 And going out, he followed him, and he knew not that it was true which was done by the angel: but thought he saw a vision.

segments.t: Et éxiens sequebátur eum, et nesciébat quia verum est quod fiébat per Angelum; existimábat autem se visum vidére.

content.latin: 10 Transeúntes autem primam et secúndam custódiam venérunt ad portam férream, quæ ducit ad civitátem, quæ ultro apérta est eis; et exeúntes processérunt vicum unum, et contínuo discéssit Angelus ab eo.
content.english: 10 And passing through the first and the second ward, they came to the iron gate that leadeth to the city, which of itself opened to them. And going out, they passed on through one street: and immediately the angel departed from him.

segments.t: Transeúntes autem primam et secúndam custódiam venérunt ad portam férream, quæ ducit ad civitátem, quæ ultro apérta est eis; et exeúntes processérunt vicum unum, et contínuo discéssit Angelus ab eo.

content.latin: 11 Et Petrus ad se revérsus, dixit: Nunc scio vere quia misit Dóminus Angelum suum, et erípuit me de manu Heródis et de omni exspectatióne plebis Iudæórum.
content.english: 11 And Peter coming to himself, said: Now I know in very deed, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

segments.t: Et Petrus ad se revérsus, dixit: Nunc scio vere quia misit Dóminus Angelum suum, et erípuit me de manu Heródis et de omni exspectatióne plebis Iudæórum.

content.latin: Theodósio iunióre imperánte, Eudócia eius uxor Ierosólymæ insígne præ céteris donum accépit férreæ caténæ, quam illam esse affirmábant, qua Petrus Apóstolus ab Heróde vinctus fúerat. Eudócia caténam pie veneráta, Romam ad fíliam Eudóxiam misit, ubi a summo Pontífice compósita cum ea, qua Neróne imperatóre idem beátus Apóstolus constríctus fúerat, ambæ inter se sic connéxæ sunt, ut non duæ, sed una caténa ab uno artífice confécta esse viderétur. Hinc, cum et ægrotórum salus et obsessórum liberátio, sacro horum vinculórum contáctu, sæpe obtinerétur, tantus honor sacris illis vínculis habéri cœpit, ut proptérea hoc nómine sancti Petri ad víncula ecclésia, título Eudóxiæ, dedicáta sit in Exquíliis, eiúsque memóriæ dies festus, profánis Gentílium solemnitátibus abólitis, institútus fúerit Kaléndis Augústi.
content.english: In the reign of the Emperor Theodosius the younger, his wife Eudocia was gifted in Jerusalem with, among other things, an iron chain, which they affirmed to be the same wherewith the Apostle Peter had been bound by King Herod. Eudocia, with godly reverence, sent this chain to her daughter Eudoxia in Rome, where it was placed by the Pope with another chain wherewith the same blessed Apostle had been shackled under the Emperor Nero. The two chains got so entangled the one with the other that they seemed no longer two but one chain made by a single workman. The very touch of these holy fetters often healed the sick and drave out devils, and so they began to receive such honour, that Eudoxia's Church of St. Peter on the Esquiline Mount was dedicated under the name of St. Peter-in-Chains, and a Feastday in its memory instituted upon the first day of August, replacing the profane festívity of the pagans held on that day.

content.latin: Quarto Nonas Augústi Luna duodevicésima Anno Dómini 2026
content.english: August 2nd 2026, the 18th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:

content.latin: Sancti Alfónsi-Maríæ de Ligório, Fundatóris Congregatiónis a sanctíssimo Redemptóre nuncupátæ, Epíscopi sanctæ Agathæ Gothórum, Confessóris et Ecclésiæ Doctóris, qui requiévit in Dómino prídie huius diéi.
content.english: At Nocera-dei-Pagani, [in Campania, Italy, in the year 1787,] holy Alphonsus Mary de Liguori, Bishop of Santa-Agata-de'-Goti, and Founder of the Congregation of the Most Holy Redeemer. Illustrious for the zeal for the salvation of souls shown both by his writings, his words, and his ensample. Pope Gregory XVI. enrolled his name with those of the Saints, and the Supreme Pontiff Pius IX. gave him the title of Doctor of the Church.

content.latin: Romæ, in cœmetério Callísti, natális sancti Stéphani Primi, Papæ et Mártyris; qui, in persecutióne Valeriáni, dum Missæ Sacrum perágeret, et, superveniéntibus milítibus, ante altáre intrépidus et immóbilis cœpta mystéria perfíceret, in sede sua decollátus est.
content.english: At Rome, in the cemetery of Callistus, [in the year 257,] the holy Pope and martyr Stephen. He was celebrating Mass during the persecution under the Emperor Valerian, when the soldiers broke in. He finished his office before the altar without fear or trembling, and then was beheaded as he sat upon his throne.

content.latin: Nicǽæ, in Bithýnia, pássio sanctæ Theodótæ, cum tribus fíliis suis. Ex his primogénitum, nómine Evódium, cum Christum fiduciáliter confiterétur, fecit primo Nicétius, Consuláris Bithýniæ, fústibus cædi; deínde matrem, cum ómnibus fíliis, igne consúmi.
content.english: At Nice, in Bithynia, [in the fourth century,] the holy Theodota and her three sons, who were all burned [alive] in the fire together by the order of Neretius, Consular of Bithynia, after he had first caused the eldest son, whose name was Evodius, to be beaten with clubs for his faithful confession of Christ.

content.latin: In Africa sancti Rutílii Mártyris, qui cum sǽpius, de loco in locum fúgiens, persecutiónem declinásset, et perículum intérdum étiam pecúnia redemísset, ex inopináto aliquándo comprehénsus est, et, Prǽsidi oblátus, torméntis cruciátur plúrimis; demum, ígnibus tráditus, egrégio martýrio coronátur.
content.english: In Africa, [in the year 211,] the holy martyr Rutilius. He had fled from one place to another in order to escape the persecution, and had sometimes bought himself out of danger, when he was unexpectedly arrested and brought before the President. He was long put to the torture, then given over to the fire, and so crowned with a noble testimony.

segments.t: Quia defecérunt sicut fumus dies mei: * et ossa mea sicut crémium aruérunt.

Psalmus 103(1-12)

content.latin: 103:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * Dómine, Deus meus, magnificátus es veheménter.
content.english: 103:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * O Lord my God, thou art exceedingly great.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * Dómine, Deus meus, magnificátus es veheménter.

content.latin: 103:1 Confessiónem, et decórem induísti: * amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto:
content.english: 103:1 Thou hast put on praise and beauty: * and art clothed with light as with a garment.

segments.t: Confessiónem, et decórem induísti: * amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto:

content.latin: 103:2 Exténdens cælum sicut pellem: * qui tegis aquis superióra eius.
content.english: 103:2 Who stretchest out the heaven like a pavilion: * who coverest the higher rooms thereof with water.

segments.t: Exténdens cælum sicut pellem: * qui tegis aquis superióra eius.

content.latin: 103:3 Qui ponis nubem ascénsum tuum: * qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum.
content.english: 103:3 Who makest the clouds thy chariot: * who walkest upon the wings of the winds.

segments.t: Qui ponis nubem ascénsum tuum: * qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum.

content.latin: 103:4 Qui facis ángelos tuos, spíritus: * et minístros tuos ignem uréntem.
content.english: 103:4 Who makest thy angels spirits: * and thy ministers a burning fire.

segments.t: Qui facis ángelos tuos, spíritus: * et minístros tuos ignem uréntem.

content.latin: 103:5 Qui fundásti terram super stabilitátem suam: * non inclinábitur in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 103:5 Who hast founded the earth upon its own bases: * it shall not be moved for ever and ever.

segments.t: Qui fundásti terram super stabilitátem suam: * non inclinábitur in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 103:6 Abýssus, sicut vestiméntum, amíctus eius: * super montes stabunt aquæ.
content.english: 103:6 The deep like a garment is its clothing: * above the mountains shall the waters stand.

segments.t: Abýssus, sicut vestiméntum, amíctus eius: * super montes stabunt aquæ.

content.latin: 103:7 Ab increpatióne tua fúgient: * a voce tonítrui tui formidábunt.
content.english: 103:7 At thy rebuke they shall flee: * at the voice of thy thunder they shall fear.

segments.t: Ab increpatióne tua fúgient: * a voce tonítrui tui formidábunt.

content.latin: 103:8 Ascéndunt montes: et descéndunt campi * in locum, quem fundásti eis.
content.english: 103:8 The mountains ascend, and the plains descend * into the place which thou hast founded for them.

segments.t: Ascéndunt montes: et descéndunt campi * in locum, quem fundásti eis.

content.latin: 103:9 Términum posuísti, quem non transgrediéntur: * neque converténtur operíre terram.
content.english: 103:9 Thou hast set a bound which they shall not pass over; * neither shall they return to cover the earth.

segments.t: Términum posuísti, quem non transgrediéntur: * neque converténtur operíre terram.

content.latin: 103:10 Qui emíttis fontes in convállibus: * inter médium móntium pertransíbunt aquæ.
content.english: 103:10 Thou sendest forth springs in the vales: * between the midst of the hills the waters shall pass.

segments.t: Qui emíttis fontes in convállibus: * inter médium móntium pertransíbunt aquæ.

content.latin: 103:11 Potábunt omnes béstiæ agri: * exspectábunt ónagri in siti sua.
content.english: 103:11 All the beasts of the field shall drink: * the wild asses shall expect in their thirst.

segments.t: Potábunt omnes béstiæ agri: * exspectábunt ónagri in siti sua.

content.latin: 103:12 Super ea vólucres cæli habitábunt: * de médio petrárum dabunt voces.
content.english: 103:12 Over them the birds of the air shall dwell: * from the midst of the rocks they shall give forth their voices.

segments.t: Super ea vólucres cæli habitábunt: * de médio petrárum dabunt voces.

Psalmus 103(13-23)

content.latin: 103:13 Rigans montes de superióribus suis: * de fructu óperum tuórum satiábitur terra:
content.english: 103:13 Thou waterest the hills from thy upper rooms: * the earth shall be filled with the fruit of thy works:

segments.t: Rigans montes de superióribus suis: * de fructu óperum tuórum satiábitur terra:

content.latin: 103:14 Prodúcens fænum iuméntis, * et herbam servitúti hóminum:
content.english: 103:14 Bringing forth grass for cattle, * and herb for the service of men.

segments.t: Prodúcens fænum iuméntis, * et herbam servitúti hóminum:

content.latin: 103:14 Ut edúcas panem de terra: * et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis:
content.english: 103:14 That thou mayst bring bread out of the earth: * and that wine may cheer the heart of man.

segments.t: Ut edúcas panem de terra: * et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis:

content.latin: 103:15 Ut exhílaret fáciem in óleo: * et panis cor hóminis confírmet.
content.english: 103:15 That he may make the face cheerful with oil: * and that bread may strengthen man’s heart.

segments.t: Ut exhílaret fáciem in óleo: * et panis cor hóminis confírmet.

content.latin: 103:16 Saturabúntur ligna campi, et cedri Líbani, quas plantávit: * illic pásseres nidificábunt.
content.english: 103:16 The trees of the field shall be filled, and the cedars of Libanus which he hath planted: * there the sparrows shall make their nests.

segments.t: Saturabúntur ligna campi, et cedri Líbani, quas plantávit: * illic pásseres nidificábunt.

content.latin: 103:17 Heródii domus dux est eórum: * montes excélsi cervis: petra refúgium herináciis.
content.english: 103:17 The highest of them is the house of the heron. * The high hills are a refuge for the harts, the rock for the irchins.

segments.t: Heródii domus dux est eórum: * montes excélsi cervis: petra refúgium herináciis.

content.latin: 103:19 Fecit lunam in témpora: * sol cognóvit occásum suum.
content.english: 103:19 He hath made the moon for seasons: * the sun knoweth his going down.

segments.t: Fecit lunam in témpora: * sol cognóvit occásum suum.

content.latin: 103:20 Posuísti ténebras, et facta est nox: * in ipsa pertransíbunt omnes béstiæ silvæ.
content.english: 103:20 Thou hast appointed darkness, and it is night: * in it shall all the beasts of the woods go about:

segments.t: Posuísti ténebras, et facta est nox: * in ipsa pertransíbunt omnes béstiæ silvæ.

content.latin: 103:21 Cátuli leónum rugiéntes, ut rápiant, * et quærant a Deo escam sibi.
content.english: 103:21 The young lions roaring after their prey, * and seeking their meat from God.

segments.t: Cátuli leónum rugiéntes, ut rápiant, * et quærant a Deo escam sibi.

content.latin: 103:22 Ortus est sol, et congregáti sunt: * et in cubílibus suis collocabúntur.
content.english: 103:22 The sun ariseth, and they are gathered together: * and they shall lie down in their dens.

segments.t: Ortus est sol, et congregáti sunt: * et in cubílibus suis collocabúntur.

content.latin: 103:23 Exíbit homo ad opus suum: * et ad operatiónem suam usque ad vésperum.
content.english: 103:23 Man shall go forth to his work, * and to his labour until the evening.

segments.t: Exíbit homo ad opus suum: * et ad operatiónem suam usque ad vésperum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 103(24-35)

content.latin: 103:24 Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti: impléta est terra possessióne tua.
content.english: 103:24 How great are thy works, O Lord? * thou hast made all things in wisdom: the earth is filled with thy riches.

segments.t: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti: impléta est terra possessióne tua.

content.latin: 103:25 Hoc mare magnum, et spatiósum mánibus: * illic reptília, quorum non est númerus.
content.english: 103:25 So is this great sea, which stretcheth wide its arms: * there are creeping things without number:

segments.t: Hoc mare magnum, et spatiósum mánibus: * illic reptília, quorum non est númerus.

content.latin: 103:26 Animália pusílla cum magnis: * illic naves pertransíbunt.
content.english: 103:26 Creatures little and great. * There the ships shall go.

segments.t: Animália pusílla cum magnis: * illic naves pertransíbunt.

content.latin: 103:27 Draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei: * ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.
content.english: 103:27 This sea dragon which thou hast formed to play therein. * All expect of thee that thou give them food in season.

segments.t: Draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei: * ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.

content.latin: 103:28 Dante te illis, cólligent: * aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.
content.english: 103:28 What thou givest to them they shall gather up: * when thou openest thy hand, they shall all be filled with good.

segments.t: Dante te illis, cólligent: * aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.

content.latin: 103:29 Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: * áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.
content.english: 103:29 But if thou turnest away thy face, they shall be troubled: * thou shalt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.

segments.t: Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: * áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.

content.latin: 103:30 Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: * et renovábis fáciem terræ.
content.english: 103:30 Thou shalt send forth thy spirit, and they shall be created: * and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

segments.t: Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: * et renovábis fáciem terræ.

content.latin: 103:31 Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: * lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis:
content.english: 103:31 May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: * the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

segments.t: Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: * lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis:

content.latin: 103:32 Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: * qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.
content.english: 103:32 He looketh upon the earth, and maketh it tremble: * he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

segments.t: Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: * qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.

content.latin: 103:33 Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo, quámdiu sum.
content.english: 103:33 I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: * I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

segments.t: Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo, quámdiu sum.

content.latin: 103:34 Iucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: * ego vero delectábor in Dómino.
content.english: 103:34 Let my speech be acceptable to him: * but I will take delight in the Lord.

segments.t: Iucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: * ego vero delectábor in Dómino.

content.latin: 103:35 Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: * bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
content.english: 103:35 Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust, so that they be no more: * O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

segments.t: Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: * bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.

content.latin: Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
content.english: O strength and stay upholding all creation,

content.latin: Immótus in te pérmanens,
content.english: Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,

content.latin: Lucis diúrnæ témpora
content.english: Yet day by day the light in due gradation

content.latin: Succéssibus detérminans:
content.english: From hour to hour through all its changes guide:

content.latin: Largíre lumen véspere,
content.english: Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,

content.latin: Quo vita nusquam décidat,
content.english: An eve untouched by shadows of decay,

content.latin: Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
content.english: The brightness of a holy death-bed blending

content.latin: Perénnis instet glória.
content.english: With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Now and to endless ages art adored.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ne tacúeris Deus, * quia sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me.
content.english: Ant. O God, be thou not silent * for the mouth of the wicked man is opened against me.

segments.t: Ant.
Ne tacúeris Deus, * quia sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me.
Psalmus 108(2-13)

content.latin: 108:2 Deus, laudem meam ne tacúeris: * quia os peccatóris, et os dolósi super me apértum est.
content.english: 108:2 God, be not thou silent in my praise: * for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.

segments.t: Deus, laudem meam ne tacúeris: * quia os peccatóris, et os dolósi super me apértum est.

content.latin: 108:3 Locúti sunt advérsum me lingua dolósa, et sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me: * et expugnavérunt me gratis.
content.english: 108:3 They have spoken against me with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred; * and have fought against me without cause.

segments.t: Locúti sunt advérsum me lingua dolósa, et sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me: * et expugnavérunt me gratis.

content.latin: 108:4 Pro eo ut me dilígerent, detrahébant mihi: * ego autem orábam.
content.english: 108:4 Instead of making me a return of love, they detracted me: * but I gave myself to prayer.

segments.t: Pro eo ut me dilígerent, detrahébant mihi: * ego autem orábam.

content.latin: 108:5 Et posuérunt advérsum me mala pro bonis: * et ódium pro dilectióne mea.
content.english: 108:5 And they repaid me evil for good: * and hatred for my love.

segments.t: Et posuérunt advérsum me mala pro bonis: * et ódium pro dilectióne mea.

content.latin: 108:6 Constítue super eum peccatórem: * et diábolus stet a dextris eius.
content.english: 108:6 Set thou the sinner over him: * and may the devil stand at his right hand.

segments.t: Constítue super eum peccatórem: * et diábolus stet a dextris eius.

content.latin: 108:7 Cum iudicátur, éxeat condemnátus: * et orátio eius fiat in peccátum.
content.english: 108:7 When he is judged, may he go out condemned; * and may his prayer be turned to sin.

segments.t: Cum iudicátur, éxeat condemnátus: * et orátio eius fiat in peccátum.

content.latin: 108:8 Fiant dies eius pauci: * et episcopátum eius accípiat alter.
content.english: 108:8 May his days be few: * and his bishopric let another take.

segments.t: Fiant dies eius pauci: * et episcopátum eius accípiat alter.

content.latin: 108:9 Fiant fílii eius órphani: * et uxor eius vídua.
content.english: 108:9 May his children be fatherless, * and his wife a widow.

segments.t: Fiant fílii eius órphani: * et uxor eius vídua.

content.latin: 108:10 Nutántes transferántur fílii eius, et mendícent: * et eiciántur de habitatiónibus suis.
content.english: 108:10 Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; * and let them be cast out of their dwellings.

segments.t: Nutántes transferántur fílii eius, et mendícent: * et eiciántur de habitatiónibus suis.

content.latin: 108:11 Scrutétur fænerátor omnem substántiam eius: * et dirípiant aliéni labóres eius.
content.english: 108:11 May the usurer search all his substance: * and let strangers plunder his labours.

segments.t: Scrutétur fænerátor omnem substántiam eius: * et dirípiant aliéni labóres eius.

content.latin: 108:12 Non sit illi adiútor: * nec sit qui misereátur pupíllis eius.
content.english: 108:12 May there be none to help him: * nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.

segments.t: Non sit illi adiútor: * nec sit qui misereátur pupíllis eius.

content.latin: 108:13 Fiant nati eius in intéritum: * in generatióne una deleátur nomen eius.
content.english: 108:13 May his posterity be cut off; * in one generation may his name be blotted out.

segments.t: Fiant nati eius in intéritum: * in generatióne una deleátur nomen eius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 108(14-21)

content.latin: 108:14 In memóriam rédeat iníquitas patrum eius in conspéctu Dómini: * et peccátum matris eius non deleátur.
content.english: 108:14 May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord: * and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

segments.t: In memóriam rédeat iníquitas patrum eius in conspéctu Dómini: * et peccátum matris eius non deleátur.

content.latin: 108:15 Fiant contra Dóminum semper, et dispéreat de terra memória eórum: * pro eo quod non est recordátus fácere misericórdiam.
content.english: 108:15 May they be before the Lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth: * because he remembered not to shew mercy,

segments.t: Fiant contra Dóminum semper, et dispéreat de terra memória eórum: * pro eo quod non est recordátus fácere misericórdiam.

content.latin: 108:17 Et persecútus est hóminem ínopem, et mendícum, * et compúnctum corde mortificáre.
content.english: 108:17 But persecuted the poor man and the beggar; * and the broken in heart, to put him to death.

segments.t: Et persecútus est hóminem ínopem, et mendícum, * et compúnctum corde mortificáre.

content.latin: 108:18 Et diléxit maledictiónem, et véniet ei: * et nóluit benedictiónem, et elongábitur ab eo.
content.english: 108:18 And he loved cursing, and it shall come unto him: * and he would not have blessing, and it shall be far from him.

segments.t: Et diléxit maledictiónem, et véniet ei: * et nóluit benedictiónem, et elongábitur ab eo.

content.latin: 108:18 Et índuit maledictiónem sicut vestiméntum, * et intrávit sicut aqua in interióra eius, et sicut óleum in óssibus eius.
content.english: 108:18 And he put on cursing, like a garment: * and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.

segments.t: Et índuit maledictiónem sicut vestiméntum, * et intrávit sicut aqua in interióra eius, et sicut óleum in óssibus eius.

content.latin: 108:19 Fiat ei sicut vestiméntum, quo operítur: * et sicut zona, qua semper præcíngitur.
content.english: 108:19 May it be unto him like a garment which covereth him; * and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.

segments.t: Fiat ei sicut vestiméntum, quo operítur: * et sicut zona, qua semper præcíngitur.

content.latin: 108:20 Hoc opus eórum, qui détrahunt mihi apud Dóminum: * et qui loquúntur mala advérsus ánimam meam.
content.english: 108:20 This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord; * and who speak evils against my soul.

segments.t: Hoc opus eórum, qui détrahunt mihi apud Dóminum: * et qui loquúntur mala advérsus ánimam meam.

content.latin: 108:21 Et tu, Dómine, Dómine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum: * quia suávis est misericórdia tua.
content.english: 108:21 But thou, O Lord, do with me for thy name’s sake: * because thy mercy is sweet.

segments.t: Et tu, Dómine, Dómine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum: * quia suávis est misericórdia tua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

Psalmus 108(22-31)

content.latin: 108:22 Líbera me quia egénus, et pauper ego sum: * et cor meum conturbátum est intra me.
content.english: 108:22 Do thou deliver me, for I am poor and needy, * and my heart is troubled within me.

segments.t: Líbera me quia egénus, et pauper ego sum: * et cor meum conturbátum est intra me.

content.latin: 108:23 Sicut umbra cum declínat, ablátus sum: * et excússus sum sicut locústæ.
content.english: 108:23 I am taken away like the shadow when it declineth: * and I am shaken off as locusts.

segments.t: Sicut umbra cum declínat, ablátus sum: * et excússus sum sicut locústæ.

content.latin: 108:24 Génua mea infirmáta sunt a ieiúnio: * et caro mea immutáta est propter óleum.
content.english: 108:24 My knees are weakened through fasting: * and my flesh is changed for oil.

segments.t: Génua mea infirmáta sunt a ieiúnio: * et caro mea immutáta est propter óleum.

content.latin: 108:25 Et ego factus sum oppróbrium illis: * vidérunt me, et movérunt cápita sua.
content.english: 108:25 And I am become a reproach to them: * they saw me and they shaked their heads.

segments.t: Et ego factus sum oppróbrium illis: * vidérunt me, et movérunt cápita sua.

content.latin: 108:26 Ádiuva me, Dómine, Deus meus: * salvum me fac secúndum misericórdiam tuam.
content.english: 108:26 Help me, O Lord my God; * save me according to thy mercy.

segments.t: Ádiuva me, Dómine, Deus meus: * salvum me fac secúndum misericórdiam tuam.

content.latin: 108:27 Et sciant quia manus tua hæc: * et tu, Dómine, fecísti eam.
content.english: 108:27 And let them know that this is thy hand: * and that thou, O Lord, hast done it.

segments.t: Et sciant quia manus tua hæc: * et tu, Dómine, fecísti eam.

content.latin: 108:28 Maledícent illi, et tu benedíces: * qui insúrgunt in me, confundántur: servus autem tuus lætábitur.
content.english: 108:28 They will curse and thou wilt bless: * let them that rise up against me be confounded: but thy servant shall rejoice.

segments.t: Maledícent illi, et tu benedíces: * qui insúrgunt in me, confundántur: servus autem tuus lætábitur.

content.latin: 108:29 Induántur qui détrahunt mihi, pudóre: * et operiántur sicut diplóide confusióne sua.
content.english: 108:29 Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: * and let them be covered with their confusion as with a double cloak.

segments.t: Induántur qui détrahunt mihi, pudóre: * et operiántur sicut diplóide confusióne sua.

content.latin: 108:30 Confitébor Dómino nimis in ore meo: * et in médio multórum laudábo eum.
content.english: 108:30 I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: * and in the midst of many I will praise him.

segments.t: Confitébor Dómino nimis in ore meo: * et in médio multórum laudábo eum.

content.latin: 108:31 Quia ástitit a dextris páuperis, * ut salvam fáceret a persequéntibus ánimam meam.
content.english: 108:31 Because he hath stood at the right hand of the poor, * to save my soul from persecutors.

segments.t: Quia ástitit a dextris páuperis, * ut salvam fáceret a persequéntibus ánimam meam.

content.english: And when Peter was come to himself, he said Now I know of a surety that the Lord hath sent His Angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

content.latin: Deus, qui beátum Petrum Apóstolum, a vínculis absolútum, illǽsum abíre fecísti: nostrórum, quæsumus, absólve víncula peccatórum; et ómnia mala a nobis propitiátus exclúde.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
