Psalmus 143(1-8)

content.latin: 143:1 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.
content.english: 143:1 Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, * and my fingers to war.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.

content.latin: 143:2 Misericórdia mea, et refúgium meum: * suscéptor meus, et liberátor meus:
content.english: 143:2 My mercy, and my refuge: * my support, and my deliverer:

segments.t: Misericórdia mea, et refúgium meum: * suscéptor meus, et liberátor meus:

content.latin: 143:2 Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: * qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
content.english: 143:2 My protector, and I have hoped in him: * who subdueth my people under me.

segments.t: Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: * qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.

content.latin: 143:3 Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? * aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
content.english: 143:3 Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? * or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

segments.t: Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? * aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?

content.latin: 143:4 Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: * dies eius sicut umbra prætéreunt.
content.english: 143:4 Man is like to vanity: * his days pass away like a shadow.

segments.t: Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: * dies eius sicut umbra prætéreunt.

content.latin: 143:5 Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: * tange montes, et fumigábunt.
content.english: 143:5 Lord, bow down thy heavens and descend: * touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

segments.t: Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: * tange montes, et fumigábunt.

content.latin: 143:6 Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: * emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
content.english: 143:6 Send forth lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: * shoot out thy arrows, and thou shalt trouble them.

segments.t: Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: * emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui omnipoténtiam tuam parcéndo máxime et miserándo maniféstas: multíplica super nos misericórdiam tuam; ut, ad tua promíssa curréntes, cæléstium bonórum fácias esse consórtes.
content.english: O God, Who declarest thine Almighty power most chiefly in showing mercy and pity, mercifully grant unto us such a measure of thy grace, that we, running the way of thy commandments, may obtain thy gracious promises, and be made partakers of thy heavenly treasure.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.
content.english: Benediction. May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Fratres: Sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
content.english: Brothers: Be sober and watch: because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Whom resist ye, strong in faith.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.
content.english: ℣. Our help is ✠ in the name of the Lord,

segments.t: Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.

content.latin: ℟. Qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: ℟. Who made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.
content.english: There follows an examination of conscience, or the Our Father said silently.

segments.t: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:
percutit sibi pectus

mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.

content.latin: Misereátur nostri omnípotens Deus, et dimíssis peccátis nostris, perdúcat nos ad vitam ætérnam. Amen.
content.english: May almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.

content.latin: Indulgéntiam, ✠ absolutiónem et remissiónem peccatórum nostrórum tríbuat nobis omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus. Amen.
content.english: May the almighty ✠ and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.
content.english: ℣. Turn us then, ✙︎ O God, our saviour:

segments.t: Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.

content.latin: ℟. Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
content.english: ℟. And let thy anger cease from us.

segments.t: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Intret orátio mea * in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. May my request * come before thee, O Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Intret orátio mea * in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.

content.latin: Psalmus 87 [1]
content.english: Psalm 87 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 87

content.latin: 87:2 Dómine, Deus salútis meæ: * in die clamávi, et nocte coram te.
content.english: 87:2 Lord, the God of my salvation: * I have cried in the day, and in the night before thee.

segments.t: Dómine, Deus salútis meæ: * in die clamávi, et nocte coram te.

content.latin: 87:3 Intret in conspéctu tuo orátio mea: * inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam:
content.english: 87:3 Let my prayer come in before thee: * incline thy ear to my petition.

segments.t: Intret in conspéctu tuo orátio mea: * inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam:

content.latin: 87:4 Quia repléta est malis ánima mea: * et vita mea inférno appropinquávit.
content.english: 87:4 For my soul is filled with evils: * and my life hath drawn nigh to hell.

segments.t: Quia repléta est malis ánima mea: * et vita mea inférno appropinquávit.

content.latin: 87:5 Æstimátus sum cum descendéntibus in lacum: * factus sum sicut homo sine adiutório, inter mórtuos liber.
content.english: 87:5 I am counted among them that go down to the pit: * I am become as a man without help, free among the dead.

segments.t: Æstimátus sum cum descendéntibus in lacum: * factus sum sicut homo sine adiutório, inter mórtuos liber.

content.latin: 87:6 Sicut vulneráti dormiéntes in sepúlcris, quorum non es memor ámplius: * et ipsi de manu tua repúlsi sunt.
content.english: 87:6 Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom thou rememberest no more: * and they are cast off from thy hand.

segments.t: Sicut vulneráti dormiéntes in sepúlcris, quorum non es memor ámplius: * et ipsi de manu tua repúlsi sunt.

content.latin: 87:7 Posuérunt me in lacu inferióri: * in tenebrósis, et in umbra mortis.
content.english: 87:7 They have laid me in the lower pit: * in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.

segments.t: Posuérunt me in lacu inferióri: * in tenebrósis, et in umbra mortis.

content.latin: 87:8 Super me confirmátus est furor tuus: * et omnes fluctus tuos induxísti super me.
content.english: 87:8 Thy wrath is strong over me: * and all thy waves thou hast brought in upon me.

segments.t: Super me confirmátus est furor tuus: * et omnes fluctus tuos induxísti super me.

content.latin: 87:9 Longe fecísti notos meos a me: * posuérunt me abominatiónem sibi.
content.english: 87:9 Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me: * they have set me an abomination to themselves.

segments.t: Longe fecísti notos meos a me: * posuérunt me abominatiónem sibi.

content.latin: 87:9 Tráditus sum, et non egrediébar: * óculi mei languérunt præ inópia.
content.english: 87:9 I was delivered up, and came not forth: * my eyes languished through poverty.

segments.t: Tráditus sum, et non egrediébar: * óculi mei languérunt præ inópia.

content.latin: 87:10 Clamávi ad te, Dómine, tota die: * expándi ad te manus meas.
content.english: 87:10 All the day I cried to thee, O Lord: * I stretched out my hands to thee.

segments.t: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, tota die: * expándi ad te manus meas.

content.latin: 87:11 Numquid mórtuis fácies mirabília: * aut médici suscitábunt, et confitebúntur tibi?
content.english: 87:11 Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? * or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to thee?

segments.t: Numquid mórtuis fácies mirabília: * aut médici suscitábunt, et confitebúntur tibi?

content.latin: 87:12 Numquid narrábit áliquis in sepúlcro misericórdiam tuam, * et veritátem tuam in perditióne?
content.english: 87:12 Shall any one in the sepulchre declare thy mercy: * and thy truth in destruction?

segments.t: Numquid narrábit áliquis in sepúlcro misericórdiam tuam, * et veritátem tuam in perditióne?

content.latin: 87:13 Numquid cognoscéntur in ténebris mirabília tua, * et iustítia tua in terra obliviónis?
content.english: 87:13 Shall thy wonders be known in the dark; * and thy justice in the land of forgetfulness?

segments.t: Numquid cognoscéntur in ténebris mirabília tua, * et iustítia tua in terra obliviónis?

content.latin: 87:14 Et ego ad te, Dómine, clamávi: * et mane orátio mea prævéniet te.
content.english: 87:14 But I, O Lord, have cried to thee: * and in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.

segments.t: Et ego ad te, Dómine, clamávi: * et mane orátio mea prævéniet te.

content.latin: 87:15 Ut quid, Dómine, repéllis oratiónem meam: * avértis fáciem tuam a me?
content.english: 87:15 Lord, why castest thou off my prayer: * why turnest thou away thy face from me?

segments.t: Ut quid, Dómine, repéllis oratiónem meam: * avértis fáciem tuam a me?

content.latin: 87:16 Pauper sum ego, et in labóribus a iuventúte mea: * exaltátus autem, humiliátus sum et conturbátus.
content.english: 87:16 I am poor, and in labours from my youth: * and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.

segments.t: Pauper sum ego, et in labóribus a iuventúte mea: * exaltátus autem, humiliátus sum et conturbátus.

content.latin: 87:17 In me transiérunt iræ tuæ: * et terróres tui conturbavérunt me.
content.english: 87:17 Thy wrath hath come upon me: * and thy terrors have troubled me.

segments.t: In me transiérunt iræ tuæ: * et terróres tui conturbavérunt me.

content.latin: 87:18 Circumdedérunt me sicut aqua tota die: * circumdedérunt me simul.
content.english: 87:18 They have come round about me like water all the day: * they have compassed me about together.

segments.t: Circumdedérunt me sicut aqua tota die: * circumdedérunt me simul.

content.latin: 87:19 Elongásti a me amícum et próximum: * et notos meos a miséria.
content.english: 87:19 Friend and neighbour thou hast put far from me: * and my acquaintance, because of misery.

segments.t: Elongásti a me amícum et próximum: * et notos meos a miséria.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 102(1-12)

content.latin: 102:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.
content.english: 102:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * and let all that is within me bless his holy name.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.

content.latin: 102:2 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.
content.english: 102:2 Bless the Lord, O my soul, * and never forget all he hath done for thee.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.

content.latin: 102:3 Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
content.english: 102:3 Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: * who healeth all thy diseases.

segments.t: Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.

content.latin: 102:4 Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
content.english: 102:4 Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: * who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

segments.t: Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.

content.latin: 102:5 Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:
content.english: 102:5 Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: * thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle’s.

segments.t: Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:

content.latin: 102:6 Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.
content.english: 102:6 The Lord doth mercies, * and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

segments.t: Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.

content.latin: 102:7 Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
content.english: 102:7 He hath made his ways known to Moses: * his wills to the children of Israel.

segments.t: Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.

content.latin: 102:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.
content.english: 102:8 The Lord is compassionate and merciful: * longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

segments.t: Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.

content.latin: 102:9 Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
content.english: 102:9 He will not always be angry: * nor will he threaten for ever.

segments.t: Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.

content.latin: 102:10 Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
content.english: 102:10 He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: * nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

segments.t: Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.

content.latin: 102:11 Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
content.english: 102:11 For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: * he hath strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.

segments.t: Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.

content.latin: 102:12 Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
content.english: 102:12 As far as the east is from the west, * so far hath he removed our iniquities from us.

segments.t: Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 102(13-22)

content.latin: 102:13 Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
content.english: 102:13 As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him: * for he knoweth our frame.

segments.t: Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.

content.latin: 102:14 Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
content.english: 102:14 He remembereth that we are dust: * man’s days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

segments.t: Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.

content.latin: 102:16 Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
content.english: 102:16 For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: * and he shall know his place no more.

segments.t: Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.

content.latin: 102:17 Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.
content.english: 102:17 But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity * and unto eternity upon them that fear him:

segments.t: Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.

content.latin: 102:17 Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:
content.english: 102:17 And his justice unto children’s children, * to such as keep his covenant,

segments.t: Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:

content.latin: 102:18 Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.
content.english: 102:18 And are mindful of his commandments * to do them.

segments.t: Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.

content.latin: 102:19 Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
content.english: 102:19 The Lord hath prepared his throne in heaven: * and his kingdom shall rule over all.

segments.t: Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.

content.latin: 102:20 Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
content.english: 102:20 Bless the Lord, all ye his angels: * you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.

content.latin: 102:21 Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.
content.english: 102:21 Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts: * you ministers of his that do his will.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.

content.latin: 102:22 Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
content.english: 102:22 Bless the Lord, all his works: * in every place of his dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Intret orátio mea in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. May my request come before thee, O Lord.

content.latin: Ut pro tua cleméntia
content.english: That with thy wonted favor thou

content.latin: Sis præsul et custódia.
content.english: Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

content.latin: Procul recédant sómnia,

content.latin: Et nóctium phantásmata;
content.english: From nightly fears and fantasies;

content.latin: Hostémque nostrum cómprime,
content.english: Tread under foot our ghostly foe,

content.latin: Ne polluántur córpora.
content.english: That no pollution we may know.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
content.english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: Salve, Regína, mater misericórdiæ;
content.english: Hail holy Queen, Mother of Mercy,

content.latin: vita, dulcédo et spes nóstra, salve.
content.english: our life, our sweetness, and our hope.

content.latin: Ad te clamámus éxsules fílii Hevæ.
content.english: To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve.

content.latin: Ad te suspirámus geméntes et flentes
content.english: To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping

content.latin: In hac lacrimárum valle.
content.english: In this valley of tears.

content.latin: Eia ergo, advocáta nostra,
content.english: Turn then, most gracious Advocate,

content.latin: illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte.
content.english: thine eyes of mercy toward us.

content.latin: Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui,
content.english: And after this our exile show unto us

content.latin: nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
content.english: the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

content.latin: O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
content.english: O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

content.latin: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
content.english: ℣. Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God.

segments.t: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.

content.latin: ℟. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
content.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

segments.t: Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui gloriósæ Vírginis Matris Maríæ corpus et ánimam, ut dignum Fílii tui habitáculum éffici mererétur, Spíritu Sancto cooperánte, præparásti: da, ut, cuius commemoratióne lætámur, eius pia intercessióne, ab instántibus malis et a morte perpétua liberémur. Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
content.english: O almighty, everlasting God, who by the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, didst prepare the body and soul of Mary, glorious Virgin and Mother, to become a worthy dwelling for Thy Son; grant that we who rejoice in her commemoration may, by her gracious intercession, be delivered from present evils and from everlasting death. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

segments.t: Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
